prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a cat version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: A cartoon illustration of a plump, laughing cat in a viral meme style. The cat has a squat, round body, a big round head, pale butter-yellow fur, and short stubby arms and legs ending in tiny paws. Its face is dominated by an enormous, wide-open laughing mouth that stretches almost across the whole face, like a frog's grin, showing a row of small white teeth and a pink tongue. Its eyes are squeezed shut into happy upward crescents, and its cheeks have rosy blush spots. It has pointed cat ears, a small pink triangle nose, and a few whiskers. Pose it mid-laugh, slightly goofy and bouncy, with its arms tucked against its belly as if laughing hard. Simple flat digital art with thick clean outlines, soft cel shading, bright cheerful colors, and a plain solid light background, with one centered character shown full body. No text, no captions, no watermarks, no other characters.
